source.issue: The generated preview contained an opaque light-neutral checker field instead of an alpha channel.

deterministicProcessing.method: Edge-connected light-neutral background flood removal, per-state tiny-component cleanup, common-scale normalization to 512x512, shared baseline placement and review composites.
deterministicProcessing.backgroundCandidate: minimum RGB channel >= 226 and maximum channel spread <= 16
deterministicProcessing.clearedStateCorrection: Tall side poles were shortened with existing source cap pixels so the cleared state reads as short stumps and a fully open passage.
